events.text: The passing of the Prophet ﷺ

hard.explain: The last two years: Tabuk, the Hajj led by Abu Bakr the same year, then the Farewell Pilgrimage with its sermon at Arafah, and the Prophet's passing in 11 AH.

The compilation of the Qur'an under Abu Bakr
